name: Trade Report 33 Choice
definition: Position/transaction reporting under the local regulation.

New.name: New
New.definition: Indicates whether transaction is reported for the first time.

Modification.name: Modification
Modification.definition: Indicates a modification to the terms or details of a previously reported transaction, but not a correction.

Correction.name: Correction
Correction.definition: Indicates that the report is correcting the erroneous data fields of a previously submitted report.

Termination.name: Termination
Termination.definition: Indicates that reported transaction is a termination or an early termination of an existing contract.

PositionComponent.name: Position Component
PositionComponent.definition: Indicates a derivative contract that is to be reported as a new trade and also included in a separate position report on the same day.

ValuationUpdate.name: Valuation Update
ValuationUpdate.definition: Indicates an update of a contract valuation or collateral.

Compression.name: Compression
Compression.definition: Indicates a compression of the reported contract.

Error.name: Error
Error.definition: Indicates a cancellation of a wrongly submitted entire report in case the contract never came into existence or was not subject to reporting requirements but was reported to a trade repository by mistake or a cancellation of duplicate report.

PortOut.name: Port Out
PortOut.definition: Indicates transfers swap transaction from one SDR to another SDR (change of swap data repository).

Revive.name: Revive
Revive.definition: Re-opening of a derivative, at a trade or position level, that was cancelled with action type ‘Error’ or terminated by mistake.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Indicates any other amendment to the contract.
